name: visual-brainstorming
description: Understand a project's real structure as a diagram, or compare visual alternatives in a local browser and record choices as structured events.

interface.shortDescription: Understand a project's structure as a diagram, or compare and select visual alternatives locally.
interface.longDescription: Visual Brainstorming has two modes. Explore mode extracts a project's real structure (separating what docs claim from what code proves) into an architecture, relationship, or flow diagram, exported as a self-contained single-file HTML. Compare mode generates offline HTML comparisons for UI, architecture, process, state, data-flow, and model-routing decisions, opening a loopback-only browser companion and recording choices and notes as project-local structured events.
defaultPrompt: Use $visual-brainstorming:visual-brainstorming to map this project's real structure into an architecture diagram, or to compare visual alternatives.
用 $visual-brainstorming:visual-brainstorming 把当前项目的真实结构画成架构图，或把待决策的视觉问题整理成可点选方案。
